claims.text: The source defines DDIM: non-Markovian forward process with identical marginals q(xt|x0) but a sigma vector controlling stochasticity (eta=0 deterministic/DDIM, eta=1 DDPM); generalised update with subsampled trajectory tau; deterministic path exposes an ODE (Euler) view with encodable latents.

Reported numbers: CIFAR-10 eta=0 FID 13.36 at 10 steps, 6.84 at 20, 4.67 at 50, 4.16 at 100 vs eta=1 41.07 at 10; 10-50x speedup with 20-100 steps matching 1000-step quality; reconstruction MSE 0.014 at 10 steps to 0.0001 at 1000.

limitations.text: FID degrades as trajectory shortens; DDPM-implementation sigma collapses at short trajectories; ODE-vs-probability-flow gap at few steps.
